meta.title: Baltimore MedTech live data workbook
meta.description: One spreadsheet-style page per source, with live queries for public APIs and explicit repository-snapshot labels for curated local datasets.
meta.live_definition: Live means the page queries the publisher or its release metadata through the MedTech Worker when opened. Repository snapshots remain versioned inputs and are never labeled live.
meta.privacy_note: The workbook exposes public aggregate and provider-directory data only. It does not retrieve patient-level records or restricted claims files.
